description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy and correlation of different methods for sentence embeddings, as measured by three metrics: Sentiment Accuracy (Sentiment Acc.), STS Correlation (STS Corr.), and Paraphrase Accuracy (Paraphrase Acc.). The vertical axis represents the accuracy and correlation values, ranging from 0 to 1, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The horizontal axis lists four different methods: Single-task baseline, Baseline with Adaptive Dropout, Unsupervised SimCSE, and Supervised SimCSE. Each method is represented by a group of three bars, each corresponding to one of the three metrics. The bars are color-coded: Sentiment Acc. is light yellow, STS Corr. is pink, and Paraphrase Acc. is light blue. The Single-task baseline method shows the lowest values across all metrics, while the Supervised SimCSE method shows the highest values. The values for Sentiment Acc. and STS Corr. are generally higher than those for Paraphrase Acc. for each method. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no visual emphasis or annotations on any of the bars.
